planned_math_to_code.statement: For two opposite rotation modes of a vector, their mean can have a smaller norm than either mode.
Choose labels k_i minimizing sum_i -log p_i,k_i + lambda sum_(i,j) ||(y_i,k_i-y_j,k_j)-R_ij(x_i-x_j)||^2.
The general discrete objective is nonconvex; beam/message/graph search is approximate and must retain its achieved objective and budget.
In general g(sum_k p_k z_k) != sum_k p_k g(z_k); for g(z)=2sigmoid(z)-1 and equal z=0,2 the values are tanh(1/2) and tanh(1)/2.
A normalized token attention row does not by itself define a calibrated distribution over target material coordinates.
The same finite labeling objective can use -log(normalized positive scores) as unary energies without claiming Bayes posterior optimality.

Localized positive-weight surface blends lie in the candidate convex hull, not necessarily on the surface. Equal nearby points on a sphere with chord length ell have radial deficit R-sqrt(R^2-ell^2/4)=ell^2/(8R)+O(ell^4/R^3).

native_experiment.primary_contrast: candidate versus strongest executable simple comparator fixed on development, plus the named operation-isolating comparisons
native_experiment.distinguishing_prediction: Benefit should concentrate on separated correspondence modes; a mean blend can improve an average score while compressing the predicted shape. This applies only after a real coordinate bank is qualified, not directly to native attention entropy. Local mean off-surface deficit can scale as curvature times squared candidate spread; this alone does not establish a joint-label advantage.
native_experiment.falsifier: Reject if naturally sourced modes are unimodal, or independent top-1/temperature-matched means match the same native performance at equal search cost. An absent or semantically unqualified candidate interface blocks instantiation and is not an empirical KILL.
